experiments.change: Replace breakout-chasing market and industry contexts with predeclared pullback-at-support states; separately test MACD repair and volume recovery without changing the underlying stock signal or trade execution.
experiments.coverage: 52,327 fixed stock trades and 2,387 non-clustered industry ETF pullback scenarios; development through 2024, 2025 validation, 2026 forward observation

specification.stock_trade: strict rising long trend plus completed daily MACD cross; next Open; structural support minus 5%; 2R; 40 sessions; stop first
specification.market_pullback: SPY and QQQ long trends intact; either index 3%-12% below prior 60D high and within 3% of EMA20/50
specification.industry_pullback: ETF long trend intact; 5%-20% below prior 60D high and within 3% of an EMA below price
specification.macd_repair: histogram rises for two completed sessions

experiments.result: Market pullback plus MACD repair was the strongest interpretable context overall: PF 1.753 and trimmed expectancy 2.491%; development/2025/2026 trimmed expectancy was 2.540%/3.435%/1.535%. The 2026 median remained -5.318%, so it is not a hard gate. Uptrend without pullback failed in 2026 with PF 0.920 and trimmed expectancy -0.656%. For industry ETFs, pullback at support produced PF 1.317 and trimmed expectancy 0.928% overall, remaining positive in development/2025/2026 at 0.944%/1.158%/0.460%. Adding MACD repair reduced overall results and failed in 2026; additionally requiring volume recovery was sample-thin and inconsistent. Compared with V1 trend-volume hotspots, whose 2026 trimmed expectancy was -2.362%, the pullback-at-support state was materially less fragile. Industry-level results remain mixed: semiconductor pullbacks with MACD and volume were positive overall, while digital assets and robotics pullbacks were weak.
experiments.decision: Promote pullback location to the primary research context for market and industry displays, but keep it outside official production score. Treat market pullback plus MACD repair as a candidate priority flag, not a buy gate. For industry, use long-trend pullback at support as the base state; show MACD and volume as descriptive evidence rather than mandatory additive factors. Continue dated forward stock-theme tracking before testing stock-level industry uplift.

historical stock-theme membership is unavailable, so industry trades use ETF proxies

experiments.result: All four stock exit grids had positive profit factor and 1% trimmed expectancy overall and in each time split, but 2026 win rates and medians weakened. The 10%-buffer/2R grid returned PF 1.366/1.455/1.231 and trimmed expectancy 1.435%/2.085%/1.206% across development/2025/2026, while 2026 median was -0.707%. Risk-Off was near flat in development; Neutral outperformed the fixed Risk-On definition, so the market label is informative but not a validated hard gate. Relative volume >=2x improved development and 2025, but 2026 median was -2.339%, so it is a visibility candidate, not a score. Top-dollar-volume signal buckets underperformed the remaining signals and do not constitute alpha. Magnificent 7 was strong in development and 2025 but failed in 2026 with only 22 samples. Chip support stayed positive by trimmed expectancy in all three periods, though 2025 median was slightly negative. Theme ETF hotspots were positive in development and 2025 but failed in 2026: PF 0.630, trimmed expectancy -2.362%, median -2.214% on 70 events. Semiconductors and grid modernization were positive in all periods, but recent samples were too small to validate.
experiments.decision: Do not change production weights. Retain 5% and 10% support buffers plus 1.5R/2R as research grids; do not select a winner post hoc. Use Risk-Off as a caution flag rather than requiring Risk-On. Show high dollar volume for liquidity/attention only. Continue relative-volume >=2x, chip support, semiconductors and grid modernization as research candidates. Redesign industry heat to include constituent volume breadth and pullback/support position before retesting; begin forward stock-theme linkage from the dated 2026-08-26 membership snapshot.

experiments.change: Test signal-date proximity to the 0.5 retracement of the latest confirmed meaningful low-to-high swing as an add-on to long trend plus daily MACD bullish cross
experiments.coverage: 2,518 eligible histories; 2000-01-03 through 2026-08-21

specification.swing: confirmed major pivot low followed by confirmed pivot high, at least 10 bars apart and at least 10% amplitude

experiments.result: Did not validate. Twenty-day win-rate deltas were -0.1, -1.7 and +1.7 percentage points. One-hundred-day deltas were -0.7, -1.5 and +4.6 points. Recent strength was not supported by development or 2025 validation.

overlapping events are not independent

experiments.change: Score six independent confirmations on top of long trend, at least 5% pullback from the prior 60-day high, and a daily MACD bullish cross
experiments.coverage: 2,518 eligible histories; 2000-01-03 through 2026-08-21; 69,265 development, 7,018 validation and 1,465 forward core events

specification.scoring: one point per component, thresholds zero through six

experiments.result: Equal-weight scoring did not validate. At 20 days, the core won 56.0%, 53.1% and 55.0%; requiring at least four confirmations produced 58.0%, 51.6% and 54.3%. At 100 days, the core won 59.1%, 60.0% and 63.5%; at least four confirmations produced 61.1%, 60.4% and 57.1%. Five- and six-point groups were too small. The overhead unfilled-gap component increased win rate in all three 20-day stages by +1.1, +2.0 and +3.6 points, but robust-return deltas were +0.07, +0.38 and -0.12, so it remains a candidate rather than a validated weight.
known_limitations: equal weighting may dilute useful components with weak ones
five- and six-point samples are insufficient
gap and FVG rules use daily OHLC rather than intraday data
overlapping events are not independent
no fees or quote-level slippage

human_summary.title_zh: 第一版等权多因子评分
human_summary.question_zh: 把多个候选因子等权相加能否形成稳定排名？
human_summary.result_zh: 整体没有通过验证；上方套牢缺口仍可作为候选风险项。
human_summary.use_zh: 不要把“命中因子多”直接等同于更好，旧V1只保留作历史对照。
human_summary.next_zh: 按类别去重、限制上限并用样本外数据验证。

experiments.change: Require both prior-close congestion and the daily-bar Volume Profile peak at the current price as a double chip-density confirmation for the fixed long-trend plus daily-MACD-cross baseline
experiments.coverage: 2,518 eligible histories; 2000-01-03 through 2026-08-21; active, delisted and unmatched-status histories retained

specification.kline_congestion: at least 15% of prior 250 closes within plus or minus 3% of current close
specification.volume_profile: highest of 40 typical-price volume bins holds at least 5% of volume and lies within 3% of current close
specification.minimum_pullback: current close at least 5% below prior 60-day high

experiments.result: Did not validate. At 20 days, win-rate deltas were +1.3, -1.8 and -2.1 percentage points; trimmed-return deltas were +0.31, -0.50 and -0.82. At 100 days, win-rate deltas were +0.2, -3.6 and -5.7 points. The 2026 100-day subset won 57.6% of 245 events, but its robust return trailed baseline by 4.86 points and only 33.2% beat SPY.
known_limitations: daily OHLCV only approximates true intraday Volume Profile
overlapping events are not independent
2,138 histories remain unmatched for listing status
no fees or historical quote-level slippage

experiments.change: Move the long-trend and K-line-congestion comparison from daily MACD crosses to completed weekly and monthly bullish MACD crosses, with one-to-six-month holding windows
experiments.coverage: 2,518 eligible histories; 2000-01-03 through 2026-08-21; 48,859 weekly and 10,993 monthly cross events before factor filtering

specification.signal: weekly or monthly MACD bullish cross confirmed only after the full period closes
comparisons: signal-date long trend plus cross plus daily-close congestion

experiments.result: Monthly crosses were materially more consistent at longer horizons than weekly crosses. Six-month raw win rates were 64.5%, 68.1% and 70.3% for monthly crosses versus 59.6%, 60.9% and 56.2% for weekly crosses. The long-trend gate changed monthly six-month win rates by only +0.4, +0.6 and -0.4 percentage points. K-line congestion did not validate as an add-on: monthly six-month deltas versus the long-trend monthly baseline were -0.3, -10.5 and -41.3 points, with only seven completed 2026 congestion samples at six months; weekly deltas were -1.1, -3.0 and +3.5 points.
known_limitations: weekly and monthly events overlap across holding windows
raw long-horizon win rates include equity-market drift
the 2026 six-month congestion subset is incomplete and too small
no fees or historical quote-level slippage

human_summary.title_zh: 周线与月线大周期信号

human_summary.use_zh: 支持继续研究“大周期看方向”，但尚不能直接确定倍数权重。
human_summary.next_zh: 用预注册V3比较日、周、月权重和持仓窗口。

experiments.change: Establish the fixed baseline for the ten-experiment rollout: signal-date long-term trend passes and daily MACD bullish cross, next-adjusted-open entry, evaluated at 20 and 100 trading days

The higher 100-day raw win rate comes with mean adverse excursions of -12.86%, -14.68% and -15.68% and is partly exposed to long-run market drift.

experiments.change: Test bottom Doji and bottom bullish engulfing within zero to four bars before a daily MACD bullish cross

specification.universe: Signal-date long-term trend passes: close at least 90% of EMA200 and EMA200 60-day decline no worse than 3%
specification.bottom: Candle body top lies in lower 30% of the trailing 60-day high-low range

specification.bullish_engulfing: Bull candle opens at or below prior bear close and closes at or above prior bear open

experiments.result: Neither candle factor validated. Bottom Doji win-rate deltas were +1.0, -2.5 and +6.3 percentage points; bottom bullish engulfing deltas were +0.7, -0.4 and +7.1 across development, 2025 validation and 2026 forward observation.
